title: THE MAYOR WHO KEPT THE FLOOD OFF THE BOOKS
deck: Mayor Jori Pell hid a failing levee so insurers would not abandon Olven's poorest quarter. With twelve hours left, Illuminara must help fourteen thousand residents organize the truth before the truth is used to discard them.
shape: Seven scenes across eighteen hours: a false gauge and a real crack, a confession in the rain, an insurer's automatic clause spoken aloud, one refused signature, medicine carried from a flooding basement, a pooled claim filed before the raw gauges go public, a spill channel cut through the mayor's own market, and a dawn in which safety, loss and responsibility all remain visible.

scenes.title: The Dry Gauge
paragraphs: *Olven river wall, gauge house · 11:42*

The gauge said the river was four metres below the crown. Outside the window, brown water licked the seventh rung of a ladder whose seventh rung was three metres below the crown. Rain pressed the discrepancy flat against the glass.

Illuminara set two fingers on the wall. The levee answered through stone, clay and the iron ties driven into it a century earlier. A seam under the old dye market had opened along forty-one metres. Water was already writing itself into the crack.

Mayor Jori Pell stood beside the brass recorder with his coat buttoned wrong. He was forty-seven, broad-shouldered, and had been elected by the quarter whose roofs spread below them. He watched her read the wall and did not pretend surprise.

**Illuminara**  
When did you lower the gauge?

**Jori Pell**  
The first time, twenty-two months ago. Twelve centimetres. Then the insurers sent a second warning, so I changed the conversion table. The river rose. The number did not.

**Illuminara**  
How long until the seam opens?

**Jori Pell**  
You tell me.

**Illuminara**  
At the present rise, shortly after midnight. Earlier if the timber crib below the market has rotted through.
He gave a single nod, as if she had confirmed a council appointment.

**Jori Pell**  
There are fourteen thousand people below us. If the raw series reaches the insurers before we move them, household review starts at once. Mortgages are called at noon tomorrow. Landlords lock the doors before the mud is dry.

**Illuminara**  
And if it does not reach them?

**Jori Pell**  
Then the water does.
He opened a drawer and took out two books. One held the public numbers in a careful clerk's hand. The other held the river as it had been: crossings-out, rain stains, and twenty-two months of truth.

**Jori Pell**  
Make me honest by morning and them homeless by noon. Then stay for the locksmiths and the banks and everyone who says the quarter should never have been here.
The wall shuddered. A cup walked three millimetres across the recorder shelf and stopped.
Illuminara did not tell him that fear did not excuse the lie. He already knew what judgment sounded like. She asked the question that changed where the next hour had to begin.

**Illuminara**  
Who can bind the residents into one claimant before you disclose?
Jori looked down through the rain at the community hall.

**Jori Pell**  
Lera Nwan. She will hate the question. She may still answer it.

scenes.title: One Claimant
paragraphs: *Low Quarter community hall · 12:35*

Lera Nwan had turned the hall into an evacuation desk before the mayor arrived. Red chalk marked streets on the floor. Residents moved wooden tokens for buses, oxygen bottles, wheelchairs and animals across it. Nobody waited for permission to be useful.

Lera listened to Jori's account without blinking. When he reached the changed conversion table, she took the public gauge sheet from his hand, tore it once, and laid both halves on the table rather than throwing them at him.

**Lera Nwan**  
My mother renewed her shop because you showed us that sheet.

**Jori Pell**  
I know.

**Lera Nwan**  
No. You know a shop. I know the room where she keeps every receipt from forty-three years because she thinks paper can make a place stay. Do not say you know.
Jori closed his mouth.
Illuminara explained the seam, the rise and the likely midnight failure in four sentences. Then she placed the two gauge books side by side. She did not touch them again.

**Illuminara**  
Olven's charter lets households threatened by one public work file as one claimant. If their claim vests before discovery, a supervised pool pauses household cancellation while fraud is contested.

**Lera Nwan**  
How many signatures?

**Jori Pell**  
Three-fifths of insured homes. The clause was written for earthquakes.

**Lera Nwan**  
And who appoints the claimant's committee?

**Illuminara**  
The residents. Not the mayor. Not me.
Lera moved six red tokens away from the river road and onto the school ridge.

**Lera Nwan**  
Then the first question is not whether we forgive him. It is whether we can move fourteen thousand people and collect eighteen hundred signatures before the wall opens.

**Jori Pell**  
The insurers will say the claim is poisoned by my fraud.

**Lera Nwan**  
Let them say it to all of us at once.
A deep knock came through the floor. On the chalk map, one wooden dog tipped over.
Lera stood it up and pushed a blank committee form toward the room. Hands reached for it. Not all of them.

An elderly baker returned his token to his pocket. He would evacuate, he said, but he would not join a claim that made him share a future with the man who had lied to him. Lera wrote his refusal beside his address. The pool would have to protect him if it won, without pretending he had agreed.
Illuminara felt something like relief, sharp and tender: the quarter was already more honest than its gauge.

scenes.title: Eleven Minutes
paragraphs: *Community hall, records room · 14:10*

Sol Tann, duty officer for the River Mutual Consortium, appeared on the wall screen in a grey room three cities away. Lera had insisted that the call be public. Two hundred residents filled the hall; hundreds more listened from doorways and radios while they packed.

**Sol Tann**  
If the mayor confirms deliberate material falsification, the cancellation engine reviews every policy linked to the gauge. I cannot suspend it by discretion.

**Lera Nwan**  
Can a common-cause claim suspend it by law?

**Sol Tann**  
If validly filed first. It needs three-fifths, a named resident committee and evidence that the cause is one public work. If the false data entered the claim, we contest it.

**Illuminara**  
The claim will use the raw gauge book, the crack map and the engineer's present measurements. Nothing derived from the public series.

**Sol Tann**  
That is clean evidence. I cannot tell you how to file it.

**Illuminara**  
Then answer only this: if the residents form the claimant first, Mayor Pell declares second, and the raw book travels inside that declaration, does the common-cause filing control household review?

**Sol Tann**  
Yes, if every part arrives within the eleven-minute window after declaration. I will not advise beyond that, and the consortium will contest the stay's scope.
A murmur crossed the hall like wind through reeds.
Lera held up the first page. Seven hundred and twelve signatures had arrived. They needed two and a half times that number.

**Jori Pell**  
I will not confess tonight.
Lera turned toward him slowly.

**Jori Pell**  
Not until the buses are loaded and the claim is ready. If one thing fails, I will not be the hand that makes both disasters happen.

**Lera Nwan**  
You were that hand twenty-two months ago.
He flinched, but did not change his answer.
Illuminara could have argued him through the logic. Instead she looked at the map. A blue token marked Vesper House, six floors, no lift, the street nearest the dye market.

**Illuminara**  
Come with me.

**Jori Pell**  
Where?

**Illuminara**  
To carry what your number left downstairs.
She waited at the door until he chose to follow.

scenes.title: What the Number Left
paragraphs: *Vesper House, Low Quarter · 15:05*

Water had not crossed the street yet, but it had entered through the drains. In Vesper House it rose black around the basement stairs, lifting jars from shelves and turning the boiler room light into a broken yellow road.

Jori knew which flat held insulin, which woman needed the narrow evacuation chair, and which boy would not leave without two white rats named Salt and Snow. His knowledge was not innocence. It was why people had trusted him enough for the lie to work.

He and Illuminara went into the basement tied to the same rope. She could have carried every crate at once. She carried one end of each, at his speed, while water reached their waists. On the fourth trip he found the old gauge notices bundled above the caretaker's desk. They were unopened, stamped with the mayor's office seal.

**Jori Pell**  
I told them not to frighten the block with notices I had already answered.

**Illuminara**  
Did you answer them?

**Jori Pell**  
I answered the insurers.

A beam cracked below the stairs. Illuminara took its weight against her shoulder long enough for Jori to drag the medicine case and the two rats through the doorway. She did not mend the building. The residents had already chosen to leave it, and the beam's failure was evidence.
Outside, river engineer Evin Ser had driven a listening rod into the street. The rod trembled visibly.

**Evin Ser**  
The crib under the dye market is gone. We have nine hours if the rise stays smooth. Seven if the upstream lock releases on schedule.

**Jori Pell**  
The lock will release. They use our public gauge.

**Evin Ser**  
Then they think we have room for their water.
Jori sat on the curb with the medicine case between his knees. The child in wet socks took the rat box, held it against his coat and looked at the sealed notices under Jori's arm.

**Child**  
My mother said the stairs were safe because your paper said so. Was that your number?
Jori looked from the child to the emptied doorway. Nobody answered for him.

**Jori Pell**  
Yes. The number was mine. I answered the insurers and left you to answer the river.
Illuminara sat beside him in the rain. She did not offer absolution or ask for the confession again.

**Jori Pell**  
I thought I was buying them time.

**Illuminara**  
Whose time was it?
Across the street, Lera's volunteers chalked SAFE on an emptied doorway. Jori watched until the last resident came out.

**Jori Pell**  
Theirs. I spent it without telling them. I will declare what I did after they have standing and before I resign. Show me where I sign after they do.

scenes.title: The Order of Truth
paragraphs: *Olven Hall, public counter · 18:52*

The counter had become a river of paper. Signatures came by bicycle, boat, school van and wet hand. Lera's committee checked each against the household register. Nobody accepted a mark made by a landlord for a tenant. The baker's refusal stayed in the margin.

At 19:06 they crossed three-fifths. At 19:12 Evin filed the crack map and certified that one public work caused the common danger. At 19:14 Sol Tann appeared on the screen and read the packet number back to the hall.

**Lera Nwan**  
The claimant stands first. Jori declares. The raw book travels inside his declaration. You resign only after the receipt holds.
Jori stood at the public microphone with the real gauge book under his hand. He looked toward Lera. She did not nod.

**Jori Pell**  
I altered Olven's river record for twenty-two months. I did it to prevent cancellation in the Low Quarter. That motive does not belong in the measurement and it does not excuse the danger. The figures I published were false. The book beside me is true.
The hall clock clicked once. On Sol Tann's screen, eleven minutes appeared in red.

Lera transmitted the resident committee charter. Evin transmitted the crack map. Jori scanned the raw book page by page while two residents watched his hands. At eight minutes, one page jammed. He reached for it; Lera reached first, flattened the fold, and passed it back without looking at his face.
At ten minutes and thirty-eight seconds, Sol Tann's screen went white.

**Sol Tann**  
Declaration and raw evidence received. Common-cause claim vested. Household cancellation is stayed for seventy-two hours. The consortium reserves fraud, recovery and coverage arguments. It cannot act household by household during the stay.
Jori waited until the white screen held, then returned to the microphone.

**Jori Pell**  
I resign as mayor effective now and submit to the court's custody after the evacuation.
The room did not cheer. A stay was not a home, and a claim was not a wall.

**Lera Nwan**  
Now tell us what we lose if we open the spill channel.
Evin unrolled the freight-yard plan. The only path that could take pressure off the levee ran through the old dye market and the municipal arcade where Lera's mother kept her receipts.

**Evin Ser**  
Seventy-two buildings flood to the lintels. Without it, four thousand do, and the current reaches the hospital road.
Jori stared at the market he had tried to keep insurable.

**Jori Pell**  
The arcade is city property. Open it.

**Lera Nwan**  
Not your decision anymore.

Lera put the seventy-two threatened addresses on the public screen. A roll call reached every occupied home and shop through the hall, the shelter radios and the bus stewards; four addresses were municipal stores or empty buildings.

**Shopkeeper**  
My family lives above number sixteen. Yes to the channel. Record the flat and the loss.

**Shopkeeper**  
No. My bakery is not a vote you may borrow because the arithmetic is large.
Lera's mother pressed both palms to the counter where she had sorted forty-three years of receipts.

**Lera's mother**  
Open through my shop. The hospital road weighs more than my paper. Do not call that consent for anybody else.
Fifty occupants or owners said yes and eighteen said no. Lera made the terms plain before the committee voted.

**Lera Nwan**  
The roll call is a hearing, not a ballot. The committee decides, and the committee carries the blame.

The committee voted under the emergency charter: nine for the channel, two against, one abstention. Lera recorded every address, every committee name and every objection before she folded the plan and handed it to Evin.

The committee put the channel damage first in the common-cause claim, with the eighteen dissenting addresses listed before the fifty yes-voters. Evin certified the cut as a public emergency work. Sol Tann's reservation left liability contested, not erased.

scenes.title: The Spill Channel
paragraphs: *Old dye market and freight yard · 22:31*
The last bus left the Low Quarter at 22:18. At 22:31 the upstream lock released, and the river rose against a city that had finally begun using the same numbers as the water.

Evin's crews cut the freight-yard paving along the buried drainage line. Illuminara lifted the three stone lintels they could not move before midnight and set them where Evin marked. When the first cut slumped, she held its banks apart while workers drove braces. She did not choose the route or change the vote. Her strength kept the chosen route open long enough to become real.
Jori worked the sandbag line in a borrowed coat. Some residents would not take a bag from him. He placed those bags where Lera pointed and did not ask them to reconsider.

At 23:47 the levee seam opened. The sound was less like an explosion than a long garment tearing in another room. Water crossed the dye market, struck the new cut and turned through the freight yard. Windows burst along the arcade. Forty-three years of Lera's mother's receipts floated against the ceiling of her shop.
Lera made a sound Illuminara would remember longer than the roar.

**Illuminara**  
I can bring the cabinet out.

**Lera Nwan**  
Not while the crew is in the cut.
Illuminara stayed with the braces. The cabinet disappeared under brown water.

At 00:26 the river stood forty centimetres below the hospital road. The channel carried the rest into the fallow basin north of the tracks. Behind them, seventy-two buildings filled. Beyond them, the school ridge shone with fourteen thousand shelter lights.
Evin touched the listening rod. Its trembling had slowed.

**Evin Ser**  
The wall is gone. The quarter is not.
Jori looked toward the flooded arcade.

**Jori Pell**  
I saved it from the insurers until I gave it to the river.

**Lera Nwan**  
You do not get the last sentence tonight.
He lowered his head. Illuminara expected an answer. None was needed.

scenes.title: The True Line
paragraphs: *Low Quarter school ridge · 05:40*

At dawn, every person on the evacuation register had been accounted for. Twelve injuries had gone to the field clinic; none was life-threatening. The hospital road remained open. The claim stay held. The first line of its damage annex named the seventy-two channel losses, with the eighteen dissenting addresses first. Sol Tann had sent three auditors and a note stating that the consortium would contest liability, not erase the claim.

Court officers took Jori's seal and asked him to remain on the ridge until the bridge reopened. He had resigned. Trial, restitution and the question of prison would come later, where his motive could be understood without becoming a pardon.
Lera's mother sat under a blanket with no receipts. She accepted tea from Illuminara and refused it from Jori. Both choices were honoured.

The resident committee set the two gauge books on an evidence cloth beside Jori. It had voted to require his sworn account of every warning and insurer call for the liability claim, from court custody and without any advisory power.

**Lera Nwan**  
When the bridge opens, the court takes you. Before then, list every warning and every call. We need your truth for the claim. We do not need your office.

**Jori Pell**  
You will have it.

Children from the shelter had found blue paint. Under Evin's direction they marked the true crest of the river on the school wall. It was higher than the false gauge had ever admitted. Beside it they painted the time the spill channel opened and the number of people who had crossed the ridge gate.
Jori watched from three steps away.

**Jori Pell**  
Will you put my name on it?

**Lera Nwan**  
On the falsified years and on the confession. Not on the evacuation. That belongs to the quarter.

**Jori Pell**  
All right.
Lera gave him a broom and pointed to the mud coming through the school doors.

**Lera Nwan**  
You may help without being thanked. The court can collect you when the bridge opens.
He took the broom.

Illuminara stood beneath the true blue line. On the evidence cloth, the baker's address and Lera's mother's shop sat beneath the same stay number, their opposite answers still recorded. Jori's broom left a clean strip through the mud and stopped three steps from her blanket. Illuminara felt the hard mercy of that distance.

A girl added one final mark at the bottom of the wall: the overturned wooden dog from the chalk map, upright again. Illuminara laughed softly when she saw it. The girl handed her the brush, and together they painted four wet paws pointing toward the ridge.

critic_line: A mayor's hidden gauge, a refused signature and one eleven-minute window: Illuminara carries and holds while the quarter decides, and fourteen thousand people are counted at dawn.

translation_sl.title: ŽUPAN, KI JE POPLAVO IZPUSTIL IZ KNJIG
translation_sl.deck: Župan Jori Pell je skrival popuščajoči nasip, da zavarovalnice ne bi zapustile najrevnejše olvenske četrti. Ker je ostalo dvanajst ur, mora Illuminara štirinajst tisoč prebivalcem pomagati organizirati resnico, preden bo resnica uporabljena za to, da jih zavržejo.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v osemnajstih urah: lažni vodomer in prava razpoka, priznanje v dežju, na glas izrečena samodejna klavzula zavarovalnice, en zavrnjen podpis, zdravila, odnesena iz poplavljene kleti, skupni zahtevek, vložen, preden se objavijo surovi odčitki, razbremenilni kanal, vrezan skozi županovo lastno tržnico, in zora, v kateri ostanejo vidni varnost, izguba in odgovornost.

scenes.title: Suhi vodomer
paragraphs: *Olvenski rečni zid, hišica z vodomerom · 11:42*
Vodomer je kazal, da je reka štiri metre pod vrhom. Zunaj okna je rjava voda oblizovala sedmo prečko lestve, katere sedma prečka je bila tri metre pod vrhom. Dež je neskladje sploščil ob steklo.

Illuminara je položila dva prsta na zid. Nasip ji je odgovoril skozi kamen, glino in železne vezi, zabite vanj pred stoletjem. Šiv pod staro tržnico barvil se je odprl vzdolž enainštiridesetih metrov. Voda se je že vpisovala v razpoko.

Župan Jori Pell je stal ob medeninastem zapisovalniku z napačno zapetim plaščem. Imel je sedeminštirideset let, široka ramena in izvolila ga je četrt, katere strehe so se razprostirale pod njima. Opazoval jo je, kako bere zid, in se ni pretvarjal, da je presenečen.

**Illuminara**  
Kdaj ste znižali vodomer?

**Jori Pell**  
Prvič pred dvaindvajsetimi meseci. Za dvanajst centimetrov. Nato so zavarovalnice poslale drugo opozorilo, zato sem spremenil pretvorbeno tabelo. Reka je rasla. Številka ni.

**Illuminara**  
Koliko časa, preden se šiv odpre?

**Jori Pell**  
Vi mi povejte.

**Illuminara**  
Ob sedanjem naraščanju malo po polnoči. Prej, če je lesena podpora pod tržnico strohnela.
Enkrat je prikimal, kakor da je potrdila sejo sveta.

**Jori Pell**  
Spodaj je štirinajst tisoč ljudi. Če surova serija doseže zavarovalnice, preden jih premaknemo, se pregled gospodinjstev začne takoj. Jutri opoldne odpokličejo hipoteke. Najemodajalci zaklenejo vrata, še preden se blato posuši.

**Illuminara**  
In če jih ne doseže?

**Jori Pell**  
Potem jih doseže voda.

Odprl je predal in vzel dve knjigi. V eni so bile javne številke, zapisane s skrbno uradniško roko. V drugi je bila reka takšna, kakršna je bila: prečrtani zapisi, dežni madeži in dvaindvajset mesecev resnice.

**Jori Pell**  
Do jutra iz mene naredite poštenega človeka, do poldneva pa iz njih brezdomce. Potem ostanite zaradi ključavničarjev in bank ter vseh, ki pravijo, da četrt nikoli ne bi smela stati tukaj.
Zid se je stresel. Skodelica se je premaknila tri milimetre po polici zapisovalnika in obstala.
Illuminara mu ni rekla, da strah ne opravičuje laži. Že je vedel, kako zveni sodba. Zastavila je vprašanje, ki je spremenilo kraj, kjer se je morala začeti naslednja ura.

**Illuminara**  
Kdo lahko prebivalce poveže v enega vlagatelja zahtevka, preden razkrijete resnico?
Jori je skozi dež pogledal navzdol proti skupnostni dvorani.

**Jori Pell**  
Lera Nwan. Sovražila bo vprašanje. Morda bo vseeno odgovorila.

scenes.title: En vlagatelj
paragraphs: *Skupnostna dvorana Spodnje četrti · 12:35*

Lera Nwan je dvorano spremenila v evakuacijsko središče, še preden je prišel župan. Rdeča kreda je po tleh označevala ulice. Prebivalci so po njih premikali lesene žetone za avtobuse, kisikove jeklenke, invalidske vozičke in živali. Nihče ni čakal na dovoljenje, da bi bil koristen.

Lera je poslušala Jorijevo pripoved, ne da bi trenila. Ko je prišel do spremenjene pretvorbene tabele, mu je iz roke vzela javni list vodomera, ga enkrat pretrgala in obe polovici položila na mizo, namesto da bi ju vrgla vanj.

**Lera Nwan**  
Moja mati je podaljšala najem trgovine, ker ste nam pokazali ta list.

**Jori Pell**  
Vem.

**Lera Nwan**  
Ne. Vi poznate trgovino. Jaz poznam sobo, kjer hrani vsak račun iz triinštiridesetih let, ker misli, da lahko papir prisili kraj, da ostane. Ne recite, da veste.
Jori je zaprl usta.
Illuminara je v štirih stavkih razložila šiv, naraščanje vode in verjetno polnočno porušitev. Nato je položila obe knjigi vodomera drugo ob drugo. Ni se ju več dotaknila.

**Illuminara**  
Olvenska listina gospodinjstvom, ki jih ogroža eno javno delo, dovoljuje vložitev skupnega zahtevka. Če njihova pravica nastane pred razkritjem, nadzorovani sklad začasno ustavi odpovedi posameznih gospodinjstev, medtem ko se obravnava goljufija.

**Lera Nwan**  
Koliko podpisov?

**Jori Pell**  
Tri petine zavarovanih domov. Klavzula je bila napisana za potrese.

**Lera Nwan**  
In kdo imenuje odbor vlagatelja?

**Illuminara**  
Prebivalci. Ne župan. Ne jaz.
Lera je šest rdečih žetonov premaknila stran od rečne ceste na šolski greben.

**Lera Nwan**  
Potem prvo vprašanje ni, ali mu odpustimo. Vprašanje je, ali lahko premaknemo štirinajst tisoč ljudi in zberemo tisoč osemsto podpisov, preden se zid odpre.

**Jori Pell**  
Zavarovalnice bodo trdile, da je zahtevek zastrupljen z mojo goljufijo.

**Lera Nwan**  
Naj to povedo vsem nam hkrati.
Iz tal je zadonel globok udarec. Na zemljevidu s kredo se je prevrnil lesen pes.
Lera ga je postavila pokonci in proti prostoru potisnila prazen obrazec za odbor. Roke so segle ponj. Ne vse.

Starejši pek je vrnil svoj žeton v žep. Evakuiral se bo, je rekel, vendar se ne bo pridružil zahtevku, zaradi katerega bi moral deliti prihodnost s človekom, ki mu je lagal. Lera je ob njegov naslov zapisala zavrnitev. Če bo sklad uspel, ga bo moral zaščititi, ne da bi se pretvarjal, da je soglašal.
Illuminara je začutila nekaj podobnega olajšanju, ostrega in nežnega: četrt je bila že bolj poštena od svojega vodomera.

scenes.title: Enajst minut
paragraphs: *Skupnostna dvorana, arhivska soba · 14:10*

Sol Tann, dežurni uradnik Konzorcija rečnih vzajemnih zavarovalnic, se je pojavil na stenskem zaslonu v sivi sobi tri mesta stran. Lera je vztrajala, da je klic javen. Dvesto prebivalcev je napolnilo dvorano; stotine drugih so poslušale iz vrat in po radiih, medtem ko so pakirale.

**Sol Tann**  
Če župan potrdi namerno bistveno ponarejanje, sistem za odpovedi pregleda vsako polico, povezano z vodomerom. Po lastni presoji ga ne morem ustaviti.

**Lera Nwan**  
Ali ga lahko skupni zahtevek zaradi enega vzroka ustavi po zakonu?

**Sol Tann**  
Če je prej veljavno vložen. Potrebuje tri petine, imenovani odbor prebivalcev in dokaz, da je vzrok eno javno delo. Če so v zahtevku lažni podatki, ga izpodbijamo.

**Illuminara**  
Zahtevek bo uporabil surovo knjigo vodomera, zemljevid razpoke in sedanje meritve inženirja. Ničesar, izpeljanega iz javne serije.

**Sol Tann**  
To so čisti dokazi. Ne smem vam povedati, kako vložiti zahtevek.

**Illuminara**  
Potem odgovorite samo na to: če prebivalci najprej oblikujejo vlagatelja, župan Pell poda izjavo kot drugi, surova knjiga pa potuje znotraj te izjave, ali skupna vložitev prevlada nad pregledom gospodinjstev?

**Sol Tann**  
Da, če vse prispe v enajstminutnem oknu po izjavi. Dlje od tega vam ne bom svetoval, konzorcij pa bo izpodbijal obseg zadržanja.
Šumenje je prešlo dvorano kakor veter skozi trstje.
Lera je dvignila prvo stran. Prispelo je sedemsto dvanajst podpisov. Potrebovali so jih še dvainpolkrat toliko.

**Jori Pell**  
Nocoj ne bom priznal.
Lera se je počasi obrnila k njemu.

**Jori Pell**  
Ne, dokler niso avtobusi polni in zahtevek pripravljen. Če spodleti ena stvar, ne bom roka, ki bo povzročila obe nesreči.

**Lera Nwan**  
Ta roka ste bili pred dvaindvajsetimi meseci.
Trznil je, vendar odgovora ni spremenil.
Illuminara bi ga lahko prepričevala z logiko. Namesto tega je pogledala zemljevid. Moder žeton je označeval Vesper House, šest nadstropij, brez dvigala, ulico najbliže tržnici barvil.

**Illuminara**  
Pojdite z menoj.

**Jori Pell**  
Kam?

**Illuminara**  
Nositi tisto, kar je vaša številka pustila spodaj.
Pri vratih je čakala, dokler se ni odločil, da ji bo sledil.

scenes.title: Kar je številka pustila
paragraphs: *Vesper House, Spodnja četrt · 15:05*
Voda še ni prečkala ulice, vendar je prišla skozi odtoke. V Vesper Houseu je črno naraščala okoli kletnih stopnic, dvigovala kozarce s polic in spreminjala luč v kotlovnici v razbito rumeno cesto.

Jori je vedel, v katerem stanovanju je inzulin, katera ženska potrebuje ozki evakuacijski stol in kateri fant ne bo odšel brez dveh belih podgan z imenoma Sol in Sneg. Njegovo znanje ni bilo nedolžnost. Zaradi njega so mu ljudje dovolj zaupali, da je laž delovala.

Z Illuminaro sta šla v klet, privezana na isto vrv. Lahko bi sama odnesla vse zaboje hkrati. Nosila je en konec vsakega, z njegovo hitrostjo, medtem ko jima je voda segla do pasu. Ob četrtem obisku je našel stara opozorila vodomera, povezana v sveženj nad oskrbnikovo mizo. Bila so neodprta in ožigosana s pečatom županovega urada.

**Jori Pell**  
Rekel sem jim, naj bloka ne strašijo z obvestili, na katera sem že odgovoril.

**Illuminara**  
Ste odgovorili nanje?

**Jori Pell**  
Odgovoril sem zavarovalnicam.

Pod stopnicami je počil tram. Illuminara je prevzela njegovo težo na ramo toliko časa, da je Jori skozi vrata odvlekel zaboj z zdravili in obe podgani. Stavbe ni popravila. Prebivalci so se že odločili, da jo zapustijo, odpoved trama pa je bila dokaz.
Zunaj je rečni inženir Evin Ser v cesto zabil prisluškovalno palico. Palica se je vidno tresla.

**Evin Ser**  
Podpora pod tržnico barvil je izginila. Imamo devet ur, če voda še naprej enakomerno narašča. Sedem, če zgornja zapornica spusti po urniku.

**Jori Pell**  
Spustila bo. Uporabljajo naš javni vodomer.

**Evin Ser**  
Potem mislijo, da imamo prostor za njihovo vodo.
Jori je sedel na robniku z zabojem zdravil med koleni. Otrok v mokrih nogavicah je vzel škatlo s podganama, jo stisnil k plašču in pogledal zapečatena obvestila pod Jorijevo roko.

**Otrok**  
Mama je rekla, da so stopnice varne, ker je tako pisalo na vašem papirju. Je bila to vaša številka?
Jori je pogledal od otroka do izpraznjenega vhoda. Nihče ni odgovoril namesto njega.

**Jori Pell**  
Da. Številka je bila moja. Odgovoril sem zavarovalnicam, vam pa pustil, da odgovorite reki.
Illuminara je sedla poleg njega v dež. Ni mu ponudila odpuščanja in ga ni znova prosila za priznanje.

**Jori Pell**  
Mislil sem, da jim kupujem čas.

**Illuminara**  
Čigav čas je bil?
Čez cesto so Lerini prostovoljci na izpraznjena vrata s kredo zapisali VARNO. Jori je gledal, dokler ni odšel zadnji prebivalec.

**Jori Pell**  
Njihov. Porabil sem ga, ne da bi jim povedal. Razglasil bom, kaj sem storil, potem ko bodo imeli pravni položaj in preden odstopim. Pokažite mi, kje podpišem za njimi.

scenes.title: Vrstni red resnice
paragraphs: *Olvenska mestna hiša, javno okence · 18:52*

Okence je postalo reka papirja. Podpisi so prihajali s kolesi, čolni, šolskimi kombiji in mokrimi rokami. Lerin odbor je vsakega preveril v registru gospodinjstev. Nihče ni sprejel oznake, ki jo je najemodajalec naredil namesto najemnika. Pekova zavrnitev je ostala na robu.

Ob 19:06 so presegli tri petine. Ob 19:12 je Evin vložil zemljevid razpoke in potrdil, da skupno nevarnost povzroča eno javno delo. Ob 19:14 se je na zaslonu pojavil Sol Tann in dvorani prebral številko svežnja.

**Lera Nwan**  
Vlagatelj je vzpostavljen prvi. Jori poda izjavo. Surova knjiga potuje znotraj njegove izjave. Odstopite šele, ko potrdilo drži.
Jori je stal ob javnem mikrofonu s pravo knjigo vodomera pod roko. Pogledal je proti Leri. Ni prikimala.

**Jori Pell**  
Dvaindvajset mesecev sem spreminjal olvenski rečni zapis. To sem storil, da bi preprečil odpovedi v Spodnji četrti. Ta motiv ne sodi v meritev in ne opravičuje nevarnosti. Številke, ki sem jih objavil, so bile lažne. Knjiga ob meni je resnična.
Ura v dvorani je enkrat kliknila. Na zaslonu Sola Tanna se je v rdečem pojavilo enajst minut.

Lera je poslala listino odbora prebivalcev. Evin je poslal zemljevid razpoke. Jori je stran za stranjo skeniral surovo knjigo, medtem ko sta mu dva prebivalca gledala pod roke. Pri osmih minutah se je ena stran zataknila. Segel je ponjo; Lera je segla prva, poravnala pregib in mu jo podala nazaj, ne da bi mu pogledala v obraz.
Pri desetih minutah in osemintridesetih sekundah je zaslon Sola Tanna pobelil.

**Sol Tann**  
Izjava in surovi dokazi so prejeti. Skupni zahtevek je pridobil pravni učinek. Odpovedi posameznih gospodinjstev so zadržane za dvainsedemdeset ur. Konzorcij si pridržuje ugovore glede goljufije, povračila in kritja. Med zadržanjem ne more ukrepati gospodinjstvo po gospodinjstvo.
Jori je počakal, da je beli zaslon ostal nespremenjen, nato se je vrnil k mikrofonu.

**Jori Pell**  
Z mesta župana odstopam z učinkom takoj in se po evakuaciji predajam v sodno pridržanje.
Prostor ni vzkliknil. Zadržanje ni bilo dom in zahtevek ni bil zid.

**Lera Nwan**  
Zdaj nam povejte, kaj izgubimo, če odpremo razbremenilni kanal.
Evin je razvil načrt tovornega dvorišča. Edina pot, ki bi lahko razbremenila nasip, je vodila skozi staro tržnico barvil in občinsko arkado, kjer je Lerina mati hranila svoje račune.

**Evin Ser**  
Dvainsedemdeset stavb bo poplavljenih do preklad. Brez tega štiri tisoč, tok pa doseže bolnišnično cesto.
Jori je strmel v tržnico, ki jo je poskušal ohraniti zavarovano.

**Jori Pell**  
Arkada je mestna last. Odprite jo.

**Lera Nwan**  
To ni več vaša odločitev.

Lera je na javni zaslon postavila dvainsedemdeset ogroženih naslovov. Poimensko preverjanje je skozi dvorano, radie v zavetiščih in spremljevalce avtobusov doseglo vsak naseljeni dom in trgovino; štirje naslovi so bili občinska skladišča ali prazne stavbe.

**Trgovka**  
Moja družina živi nad številko šestnajst. Da kanalu. Zapišite stanovanje in izgubo.

**Pek**  
Ne. Moja pekarna ni glas, ki si ga lahko izposodite, ker so številke velike.
Lerina mati je pritisnila obe dlani ob pult, kjer je urejala triinštirideset let računov.

**Lerina mati**  
Odprite skozi mojo trgovino. Bolnišnična cesta tehta več kot moj papir. Tega ne imenujte soglasje kogar koli drugega.
Petdeset stanovalcev ali lastnikov je reklo da, osemnajst pa ne. Lera je jasno povedala pogoje, preden je odbor glasoval.

**Lera Nwan**  
Poimensko preverjanje je zaslišanje, ne glasovanje. Odbor odloča in odbor nosi krivdo.

Odbor je glasoval po listini za izredne razmere: devet za kanal, dva proti, eden se je vzdržal. Lera je zapisala vsak naslov, vsako ime člana odbora in vsak ugovor, preden je zložila načrt in ga izročila Evinu.

Odbor je škodo zaradi kanala postavil na prvo mesto skupnega zahtevka, osemnajst nasprotujočih naslovov pa pred petdesetimi, ki so rekli da. Evin je vrez potrdil kot javno delo v izrednih razmerah. Pridržek Sola Tanna je odgovornost pustil sporno, ne izbrisano.

scenes.title: Razbremenilni kanal
paragraphs: *Stara tržnica barvil in tovorno dvorišče · 22:31*
Zadnji avtobus je Spodnjo četrt zapustil ob 22:18. Ob 22:31 se je odprla zgornja zapornica in reka je narasla proti mestu, ki je končno začelo uporabljati iste številke kot voda.

Evinove ekipe so rezale tlak tovornega dvorišča vzdolž zakopane odtočne cevi. Illuminara je dvignila tri kamnite preklade, ki jih pred polnočjo niso mogli premakniti, in jih postavila tja, kamor je označil Evin. Ko se je prvi vrez sesedel, je njegove bregove držala narazen, medtem ko so delavci zabijali opore. Ni izbrala poti in ni spremenila glasovanja. Njena moč je izbrano pot držala odprto dovolj dolgo, da je postala resnična.

Jori je delal v vrsti z vrečami peska v izposojenem plašču. Nekateri prebivalci niso hoteli vzeti vreče iz njegovih rok. Te vreče je položil tja, kamor je pokazala Lera, in jih ni prosil, naj premislijo.

Ob 23:47 se je odprl šiv nasipa. Zvok je bil manj podoben eksploziji kakor dolgemu trganju oblačila v drugi sobi. Voda je prečkala tržnico barvil, udarila v novi vrez in zavila skozi tovorno dvorišče. Okna vzdolž arkade so počila. Triinštirideset let računov Lerine matere je plavalo ob stropu njene trgovine.
Lera je izdala zvok, ki si ga bo Illuminara zapomnila dlje od rjovenja.

**Illuminara**  
Omari lahko prinesem ven.

**Lera Nwan**  
Ne, dokler je ekipa v vrezu.
Illuminara je ostala pri oporah. Omara je izginila pod rjavo vodo.

Ob 00:26 je reka stala štirideset centimetrov pod bolnišnično cesto. Kanal je preostalo vodo odvajal v neobdelano kotanjo severno od tirov. Za njimi se je polnilo dvainsedemdeset stavb. Onkraj njih je šolski greben žarel s štirinajst tisoč lučmi zavetišča.
Evin se je dotaknil prisluškovalne palice. Njeno tresenje se je upočasnilo.

**Evin Ser**  
Zidu ni več. Četrt je.
Jori je pogledal proti poplavljeni arkadi.

**Jori Pell**  
Rešil sem jo pred zavarovalnicami, dokler je nisem izročil reki.

**Lera Nwan**  
Nocoj vam ne pripada zadnji stavek.
Spustil je glavo. Illuminara je pričakovala odgovor. Ni bil potreben.

scenes.title: Prava črta
paragraphs: *Šolski greben Spodnje četrti · 05:40*

Ob zori so bili evidentirani vsi ljudje iz evakuacijskega registra. Dvanajst poškodovanih je odšlo v terensko ambulanto; nobena poškodba ni bila življenjsko nevarna. Bolnišnična cesta je ostala odprta. Zadržanje zahtevka je držalo. Prva vrstica njegove priloge o škodi je imenovala dvainsedemdeset izgub zaradi kanala, najprej osemnajst nasprotujočih naslovov. Sol Tann je poslal tri revizorje in obvestilo, da bo konzorcij izpodbijal odgovornost, ne pa izbrisal zahtevka.

Sodni uradniki so vzeli Jorijev pečat in ga prosili, naj ostane na grebenu, dokler se most znova ne odpre. Odstopil je. Sojenje, povračilo in vprašanje zapora bodo prišli pozneje, kjer bo njegov motiv mogoče razumeti, ne da bi postal pomilostitev.
Lerina mati je brez računov sedela pod odejo. Sprejela je čaj od Illuminare in ga zavrnila od Jorija. Obe izbiri sta bili spoštovani.

Odbor prebivalcev je obe knjigi vodomera položil na dokazno platno ob Joriju. Glasoval je, da mora iz sodnega pridržanja in brez kakršne koli svetovalne moči za odškodninski zahtevek pod prisego popisati vsako opozorilo in vsak klic zavarovalnici.

**Lera Nwan**  
Ko se most odpre, vas prevzame sodišče. Do takrat naštejte vsako opozorilo in vsak klic. Za zahtevek potrebujemo vašo resnico. Vašega urada ne potrebujemo.

**Jori Pell**  
Dobili jo boste.

Otroci iz zavetišča so našli modro barvo. Po Evinovih navodilih so na šolski zid označili pravi vrh reke. Bil je višji, kot je lažni vodomer kadar koli priznal. Poleg njega so naslikali čas odprtja razbremenilnega kanala in število ljudi, ki so šli skozi vrata grebena.
Jori je gledal s treh korakov razdalje.

**Jori Pell**  
Boste nanj zapisali moje ime?

**Lera Nwan**  
Na ponarejena leta in na priznanje. Ne na evakuacijo. Ta pripada četrti.

**Jori Pell**  
Prav.
Lera mu je dala metlo in pokazala na blato, ki je prihajalo skozi šolska vrata.

**Lera Nwan**  
Pomagate lahko brez zahvale. Sodišče vas lahko pobere, ko se most odpre.
Vzel je metlo.

Illuminara je stala pod pravo modro črto. Na dokaznem platnu sta pekov naslov in trgovina Lerine matere stala pod isto številko zadržanja, njuna nasprotna odgovora pa sta bila še vedno zapisana. Jorijeva metla je skozi blato pustila čist pas in se ustavila tri korake od njene odeje. Illuminara je začutila trdo milost te razdalje.

Deklica je na dnu zidu dodala še zadnjo oznako: prevrnjenega lesenega psa z zemljevida s kredo, znova pokončnega. Illuminara se je tiho zasmejala, ko ga je zagledala. Deklica ji je podala čopič in skupaj sta naslikali štiri mokre šape, usmerjene proti grebenu.

translation_sl.critic_line: Županov skriti vodomer, zavrnjen podpis in eno enajstminutno okno: Illuminara nosi in drži, medtem ko četrt odloča, ob zori pa preštejejo vseh štirinajst tisoč ljudi.
